name: MSG_PICKUP
meaning: attach, anim 0, SetState(HELD), shadow hidden, Emitter_Reset

name: MSG_DROP
meaning: detach, SetPosition(arg), anim 4, SetState(WORLD), shadow shown; Emitter_Reset only when arg flag bit 0 is set

name: MSG_QUERY_NEAREST_TARGET
meaning: playing and Sam within 300: {1, dist*0xffff/300}, returns 1

name: MSG_HELD_STATE_BEGIN
meaning: from the Wolf only: SetState(PLAYING), Sound_Play(0x25)
